# ETH-USD — Technical Analysis Report
**Analysis date: 2026-10-26 | Instrument: ETH-USD (Ethereum USD, CCC) | Asset class: Cryptocurrency (no company fundamentals apply)**

---

## 1. Executive Summary

ETH-USD is in a **medium-term correction within an intact long-term uptrend**. The verified close on 2026-10-26 is **$2,303.42**, down roughly **14.9% from the Oct 1 close ($2,705.54)** and about **17.0% below the cycle peak close ($2,776.47 on Sept 21)**. Price sits below a falling 10 EMA ($2,383.47) and a rolling-over 50 SMA ($2,539.12), but still **+6.7% above a rising 200 SMA ($2,157.87)**. Momentum (MACD at **−60.12**, below its signal at **−47.25**) is still deteriorating with no bullish divergence yet, while RSI (**32.52**) is pressing toward oversold and price is pinned against the **Bollinger lower band ($2,298.73)**. The tape is bearish but approaching a dense support confluence; risk management — not prediction — is the priority given ATR of **$86.97 (~3.8% of price)**.

---

## 2. Indicator Selection Rationale (8 selected, redundancy avoided)

| Category | Selected | Purpose here | Why not the alternates |
|---|---|---|---|
| Moving Averages | **close_200_sma, close_50_sma, close_10_ema** | Three-horizon trend map: structural regime (200), swing trend (50), entry timing (10) | Only one per horizon; no duplicates |
| MACD | **macd, macds** | Trend-momentum state + crossover trigger | macdh (histogram) is derivable from macd−macds (I compute it below from their verified values, e.g. Oct 26: −60.12 − (−47.25) = **−12.86**) |
| Momentum | **rsi** | Oversold pressure gauge for a falling market | No second oscillator (e.g., stoch) — redundant with RSI |
| Volatility | **atr** | Stop-loss/position sizing in a high-vol regime | Bollinger trio skipped as primary picks to avoid triple-counting one system; snapshot band values used as verification only |
| Volume | **vwma** | Volume-confirmed trend/distribution check | Only volume tool needed |

This set gives complementary coverage: **trend (3 MAs) + momentum (MACD/RSI) + volatility (ATR) + volume confirmation (VWMA)**.

---

## 3. Price Action Narrative (from retrieved OHLCV history)

- **April–May (range top):** ETH-USD traded ~$2,250–2,400 through late April/early May (e.g., close $2,369.73 on Apr 26), then bled lower through May to ~$2,000.
- **Early June crash:** Sharp breakdown — June 5 saw a $1,540.16 intraday low (close $1,580.86); the **$1,506.51 intraday low on June 6** marks the cycle bottom.
- **June–July recovery:** Choppy grind back from ~$1,570 to the $1,750–1,950 zone.
- **August breakout:** A violent leg higher — from $1,916.46 (Aug 18 close) to $2,515.28 (Aug 21 close), a **+31.2% three-session move** on extreme volume (33.3B units Aug 21), followed by consolidation $2,420–2,515.
- **September rally to peak:** Higher lows into the **$2,776.47 close on Sept 21** (intraday high $2,805.50), then a $2,650–2,750 range.
- **October breakdown:** The Oct 4 local high close ($2,726.51) failed. **Oct 7–8** delivered the decisive breakdown — closes $2,573.53 and $2,471.91 on ~20.1B volume each day (among the heaviest of the entire dataset). Since then the market has printed **lower highs and lower lows** (Oct 11: $2,534.70 → Oct 21: $2,470.77 → Oct 26: $2,303.42) with no successful reclaim attempt.

---

## 4. Trend Structure — Three Horizons

**Long-term (200 SMA = $2,157.87): BULLISH but compressing.**
The 200 SMA has risen steadily from ~$2,004 (mid-August) to $2,157.87, and it is still climbing (~+1.7/day over the last week, verified values: $2,149.28 Oct 19 → $2,157.87 Oct 26). Price remains +6.7% above it. The structural regime has not flipped — but the cushion is thinning fast as price descends toward a rising mean.

**Medium-term (50 SMA = $2,539.12): BEARISH turn.**
The 50 SMA peaked at $2,556.07 (Oct 13) and has since rolled over to $2,539.12 — the first sustained decline of this average since the August breakout. Price broke below the 50 SMA during the Oct 7–8 breakdown and is now **9.3% below it**. This is the key damage: the swing trend that carried the August–September rally is now down.

**Short-term (10 EMA = $2,383.47): BEARISH and steepening.**
The 10 EMA has fallen nearly every session since Oct 6 ($2,692.12 → $2,383.47). Price is $80 below it and the EMA is descending ~15–20 points/day. The full bearish stack — **price < 10 EMA < 50 SMA** — means rallies are likely to be sold until price reclaims at least the 10 EMA.

---

## 5. Momentum — MACD and RSI

**MACD (−60.12) vs Signal (−47.25): active sell regime, still accelerating.**
- MACD crossed **below zero around Oct 10–11** (verified: +3.23 on Oct 10 → −2.07 on Oct 11), converting the early-October sell trigger into a full trend-mode signal.
- The implied histogram (MACD − Signal) is **still widening**: −9.11 (Oct 21) → −10.07 (Oct 24) → −11.48 (Oct 25) → **−12.86 (Oct 26)**. Bearish momentum is *decelerating in no dimension yet* — there is no histogram contraction, hence no early bottoming tell.
- Perspective: MACD peaked at +169.24 (Aug 27) and +117.70 (Sept 6); the swing from +70.20 (Oct 2) to −60.12 (Oct 26) is one of the fastest momentum collapses in the retrieved window — consistent with the -14.9% October slide.
- **No bullish divergence:** price made a lower low today vs Oct 8 ($2,303.42 vs $2,471.91), and MACD made a lower low too (−60.12 vs +27.32). Divergence-watch resumes only if price makes marginal new lows while MACD holds above ~−60.

**RSI 32.52: near-oversold, but no divergence.**
- RSI has traced lower highs through the whole decline: 63.97 (Oct 1) → 45.35 (Oct 7) → 44.53 (Oct 11) → 45.94 (Oct 21) → **32.52 (Oct 26)** — its lowest verified reading since the August rally began (prior low in window: ~37.19 Oct 17).
- It is **2.5 points above the classic 30 threshold**, having never printed sub-30 during this decline. In crypto downtrends, RSI can pin at 20–35 for weeks; treat 30 as a zone, not a line.
- The absence of RSI divergence at today's new price low means the oversold condition is *unconfirmed* as a reversal signal — it licenses caution on new shorts, not long entries.

---

## 6. Volatility — ATR (Risk Management Layer)

- **ATR = $86.97 (~3.78% of price)**, elevated versus the calm mid-September stretch (~$85–95 was typical all month; it spiked above $100 during the Sept 21–23 breakout whipsaw).
- ATR has eased from its ~$95 mid-October highs ($94.94 Oct 16) to $86.97, but remains far above quiet-regime levels — **every session still carries ~$87 of expected true range**.
- Practical implications:
  - Stop-losses tighter than ~1.5×ATR (~$130) below entry are likely to be noise-stopped.
  - Position size should be scaled to the ATR: at these levels, a 2×ATR adverse move (~$174, ~7.5%) is a *normal* adverse excursion, not a tail event.
  - The Oct 26 true range was $41.42 (high $2,335.76 − low $2,294.34) — below ATR, i.e., today was a *quiet* down day inside a high-vol regime, which often precedes either a relief bounce or a range-expansion continuation.

---

## 7. Volume Confirmation — VWMA

- **VWMA = $2,410.55, declining**, and price is $107 below it. The volume-weighted average cost of the recent window's participants is underwater — distribution, not accumulation, characterizes October.
- VWMA has fallen from its $2,704.22 peak (Oct 4) every session since — it has confirmed every leg down, in contrast to the August phase when price closed *above* a rising VWMA (verified: Aug 21 close $2,515.28 vs VWMA $2,530.34 was the one marginal exception, resolved decisively higher Aug 24–26).
- Volume texture of the decline: the Oct 7–8 breakdown ran ~20.1B units/day (heaviest since August); the most recent slide has been on lighter flow (Oct 25: 6.09B) — but the verified Oct 26 volume of **10.68B on a red close** shows sellers still step in on follow-through days. No capitulation signature (climactic volume + long lower wick) is yet visible in the verified data.

---

## 8. Bollinger Band Context (verified snapshot values)

- Middle: **$2,433.83** | Upper: **$2,568.92** | Lower: **$2,298.73**
- Band width ≈ $270 (~11.7% of price) — wide, reflecting the October trend expansion.
- The close ($2,303.42) is **only $4.69 above the lower band**, i.e., price is riding the band — in strong downtrends this is *continuation* behavior, not automatically a bounce signal. The band provides a location for mean-reversion attempts, but a trigger (e.g., a close back above the 10 EMA) is required.

---

---

## 10. Scenarios & Actionable Insights

**Base case (bearish bias, nearing exhaustion zone):** The trend stack, MACD regime, and VWMA all point down; bounces toward $2,383–2,434 are candidates for fading while those levels hold. Momentum traders should wait for the **MACD histogram to stop widening** (first contraction from −12.86) before interpreting stabilization.

**Bear continuation trigger:** A verified daily close below **$2,280.55** (Oct 24 low) breaks the near-term floor; with the lower band pierced, the measured path points to the **$2,158–2,200 zone** where the rising 200 SMA should act as the strategic defense. A decisive 200-SMA loss would flip the long-term regime and materially change this framework.

**Bull reversal trigger (confirmation-required):** A close back above **$2,383.47 (10 EMA)** would be the first structural crack in the downtrend; a follow-through close above **$2,433.83 (Boll middle)** would target the $2,470–2,539 supply band. Until then, oversold RSI + band-rider status is location, not signal.

**Risk management:** With ATR at $86.97, size positions so a 1.5–2×ATR adverse move is survivable; expect $80–90 daily ranges. Avoid adding to shorts on RSI sub-33 flushes without fresh downside confirmation, and avoid knife-catch longs without a 10-EMA reclaim.
